meta.title: Priest data sheet for WoW Forever (level 60 vs a level 63 training dummy): Shadow, experimental Smite (Discipline/Holy damage) and hybrids
meta.scope: Spell table and caster rules, every damage ability a level-60 priest uses against a raid boss (plus utility and racial spells with icons), procs and personal debuffs, mana economy, the three talent trees in gunba's order with per-rank values, every priest damage build in gs, fs and the MythicSim engine, priority lists, default stats, worked examples, sim disagreements and the practice-yard engine gaps. Healing builds are out of scope; their talents are listed only for talent strings.
meta.howToRead: Every number is an object {value, unit, source, confidence, note}. 'source' is a GitHub permalink (repo@commit/path#Lline), a URL, or a list of them. 'confidence' is one of the three values in confidenceLegend. Spell rows cited as fs sim/core/spelldata/spells_auto_gen.go are the beta client rows (build 1.60.1.70124) stored in foreversim.

confidenceLegend.confirmed-forever: Stated by Forever client data (spell rows, talent curves), a Wowhead Forever tooltip, Blizzard (development notes, class deep dive), or measured on the beta. Most beta measurements were taken at levels 10-30.
confidenceLegend.sim-provisional: A modelling choice of one or more sims with no Forever source yet, or where sources disagree (including developer-style bug-tracker replies not flagged as Blizzard). Use it, but expect it to change.
confidenceLegend.classic-fallback: Forever data is silent, so the sims keep the Classic 1.12 / Classic Era value.

simsCompared.gs: gunba/wow-forever-sim (branch 'forever'), commit 9c05fc890b (2026-10-09). Separate Shadow and Smite specs. Priest tree 18/17/18. Penance follows the 8 Oct retune (rank 4: 92 per bolt at 0.19, 385 mana). Ranked: Shadow 18/0/33 ~825-833 DPS, Smite 31/17/3 ~444-464 DPS (modeled ilvl 65, raid buffs, 300 s).
simsCompared.fs: laurencestokes/foreversim (branch 'master'), commit 255df1627f (2026-10-01). One 'DPS priest' spec with Shadow and Smite presets, beta client rows 1.60.1.70124. Same tree order as gs. Models Shadowfiend as an option. Tests use naked gear, so its DPS numbers are not meaningful.
simsCompared.ms: sage3648/mythicsim-forever-engine-go (MythicSim's engine, MIT), commit 8361dcca54 (2026-10-10). A fork of the fs codebase with newer client masks (70170; the tier list says client 70334). Secondary. Adds a Smite APL that casts Mind Blast.

practiceYardSummary: Spell table vs +3: 17% miss with a 1% floor (16% hit caps); average 6% partial resist on non-binary Shadow and Holy damage (gs); Mind Flay is binary. Crit 1.5x, 2.0x for Shadow spells in Shadowform. No crit suppression in the sims.
Shadow Weaving (3/3): every landed Shadow damage spell adds a stack, +2% Shadow damage from you, 5 stacks, 15 s. Personal (an aura on the target that only counts your damage); not a raid debuff.

Shadowform: +10% Shadow damage, -50% Shadow mana cost, 2.0x Shadow crits, -15% physical taken; 40% base mana to enter, 1.5 s cooldown; no healing spells, no Penance. Darkness 5/5 +10%. Together with 5 Weaving stacks: x1.331.

Mind Flay: 3 ticks x (130 + 0.167 SP) over 3 s, 205 mana, 20 yd (30 with Improved Mind Flay 2/2, which adds +20%). Hit rolled once at cast; ticks crit. Not sped up by casting haste. Clip only right after a tick (2nd tick at 2.0 s) when Mind Blast or Death is ready.

Shadow Word: Pain 6 ticks x (127 + 0.2 SP) every 3 s (8 with Improved SWP 2/2); Devouring Plague 8 x (106 + 0.1 SP), 1 min cooldown, heals you; Shadow Word: Death 444-472 + 0.429 SP, 15 s, 10% max-health backlash on every non-lethal hit. DoTs crit and do not snapshot.

Smite (experimental): Smite 166-187 + 0.714 SP, 2.0 s with Divine Fury; Holy Fire 184-232 + 0.75 SP and 5 x (15 + 0.05 SP) over 10 s, 3.0 s; Power in Light +10% Smite/Penance while your Holy Fire burns; Penance 3 bolts x (92 + 0.19 SP) at 0/1/2 s, 12 s. Mind Blast is ~1.8x Smite per cast-second.
Mana: Shadow ~3,970/min, Smite ~5,980/min in gs; a solo dummy regains ~840/min. Offer raid Judgement of Wisdom, Blessing of Wisdom and Mana Spring toggles plus potions and runes.
meta.wowheadNote: Wowhead Forever talent tooltips print stale or rank-1 raw values (Power in Light 15%, Improved Mind Blast 3 s, Divine Fury 1 s, Searing Light 10%, Shadow Affinity 8%, Litany of Light 20%, Spiritual Healing 2%, Martyrdom/Inspiration/Spirit Tap 0%). This sheet uses gs's tree (client trait curves). Ability tooltips match the client rows but print scaling spells at the rank's max scaling level (Mind Blast 485-511, Holy Fire 196-244, SWD 447-474); the sims use level-60 values.

castingRegen.unit: % of Spirit regen kept while casting

mp5.value: MP5 / 5 per second, also while casting

fiveSecondRule.value: Spending mana starts a 5 s window in which Spirit regen is reduced to the casting share; MP5 keeps ticking

creatureType.value: gs's reference dummy is Dragonkin. Chastise needs a Humanoid; Shadow T1 4-piece bonus vs Undead.

executePhase.value: Early Demise (+15/30% SWD crit) needs the target at or below 20% health; an endless dummy needs a toggle. gs also skips SWD's backlash when the hit kills.

critSuppression.note: gs does not subtract spell crit vs +3.

shadowformCrit.note: +100% crit damage bonus (1.5x -> 2.0x). Scope disputed: gs all Shadow spells; fs MB, MF, SWP, DP (client mask 41984016, also Mana Burn); ms adds SWD.

partialResists.value: average 6% damage reduction on non-binary Shadow and Holy damage vs +3, DoT ticks included
partialResists.note: Level-based: 2% per level x3. Bug #81 (Spell Piercing ~0.6%/point, a 'Vulnerability Damage' line) hints at a new resistance model. https://github.com/ClassicWoWCommunity/forever-bugs/issues/81

binarySpells.note: All-or-nothing: no partial resists; the hit is rolled once when the channel starts.

value.note: Every priest spell, including channels and Shadowform.

hasteRule.value: Casting speed shortens spell GCDs to a 1.0 s floor

castingAndMoving.value: No casts and no channels while moving; moving breaks a channel. Instants are usable on the move: SWP, DP, SWD, VE, Holy Nova, Shadowform, Inner Focus, Power Infusion, Power Word: Shield

mindFlayTicks.value: 3 ticks at 1, 2 and 3 s after the start

penanceBolts.value: 3 bolts at 0, 1 and 2 s (a 2 s channel; fixed 8 Oct)

clipping.value: A new spell after the GCD ends the channel; remaining ticks are lost (whole-tick model in all sims)

partialTickOnClip.value: Beta: a channel cut short deals its last tick in proportion to the time spent (Arcane Missiles excepted)
partialTickOnClip.note: Developer-style reply, issue open. Not modelled by any sim.

queueing.value: Channels (Mind Flay) cannot be queued in Forever

haste.value: fs and ms: Mind Flay is never hastened. gs: only a 'spell haste' stat (no current gear) shortens channels; Berserking does not

clipDelay.note: gs and fs UI default channel clip delay (latency).

dynamic.value: Ticks use your current spell power and modifiers (no snapshot)

crit.value: DoT ticks can crit (Forever ruleset); Devouring Plague since 1 Oct
crit.note: fs (1 Oct) still reads DP's old 'Periodic Can Crit' flag as off; ms (client 70170) has it on.

refresh.value: Recasting restarts the DoT; the pending partial tick is lost

pushback.value: gs: 1.0 s, then 0.2 s less per hit (min 0.2). Beta: casts take no pushback from spell hits (#188, open). Twilight Focus 23/47/70% avoids it. Only relevant when the dummy attacks

threat.value: 1.0x on all damage in the sims. Shadow Affinity -10/20/30% Shadow threat, Silent Resolve -10/20/30% Holy; Holy Nova no threat; Fade -4,100 threat for 10 s (doubled per the deep dive). Mind Blast's tooltip still says 'high threat'

shadowHint.name: Practice-yard hint, Shadow (ours)
shadowHint.source: our synthesis of apl.shadowGsRanked and apl.shadowFs
steps: Before the pull: Shadowform (550 mana); optional Inner Fire.
Shadow Word: Pain whenever it is not ticking; recast right after its last tick, never early (a recast restarts it and loses the pending tick). 24 s with Improved SWP 2/2.
Devouring Plague whenever it is off cooldown (60 s cooldown, 24 s DoT). Inner Focus first saves its mana.
Shadow Word: Death on cooldown (15 s); each cast costs 10% of max health on the dummy.
Mind Blast on cooldown (5.5 s); Inner Focus -> Mind Blast is the crit use.
Mind Flay as filler: let it tick at least twice; clip right after a tick only when Mind Blast or Death is ready or a DoT fell off; never cut it mid-tick.
Five landed Shadow spells build 5 Shadow Weaving stacks; any Shadow spell within 15 s keeps them.
Stand within 30 yd (Improved Mind Flay 2/2) or 20 yd without it.
Potion or rune at ~40% mana; Undead: Dark Sacrifice once 1,600 mana are missing.

smiteHint.name: Practice-yard hint, Smite (ours)
smiteHint.source: our synthesis of apl.smiteGs, apl.smiteFs and apl.smiteMsMindBlast
steps: Before the pull: Holy Fire at -3 s (3.0 s cast with Divine Fury 5/5).
Holy Fire when its DoT has < 3 s left, so it lands as the old DoT ends and Power in Light (+10% Smite) never drops.
Power Infusion + Inner Focus + Smite together every 3 min.
Shadow Word: Pain when it is missing and mana >= 30% (fs/ms).
Mind Blast on cooldown while mana >= 30% (ms variant; ~1.8x Smite per cast-second).
Penance only when mana is plentiful (gs dropped routine Penance after the 8 Oct retune); never in Shadowform.
A free Holy Nova (Holy Purpose proc) only within 10 yd.
Under ~20% mana drop the optional spells first: Mind Blast, SWP, then Penance.

Mid-tick clips lose a whole tick (sims) or deal a partial tick (beta #21).

engineGaps: Channel haste: startChannel divides the channel by castHaste(), so Berserking would speed up Mind Flay; the Forever sims do not. Add channel.hasted (default false).
Channels can start while moving: blocker() only checks castTime > 0.
A tick at the start of a channel (Penance's first bolt at 0 s).
One hit roll per channel: a missed Mind Flay must not tick (use() runs first but cannot cancel the channel).
Optional partial last tick when a channel is clipped (beta #21) and an option to forbid queueing channels (#230).

A stacking personal debuff on the target: Shadow Weaving adds a stack and refreshes 15 s per landed Shadow spell; applyAura replaces auras, so add addStack(target, id, max, duration). Show it on the target, not in the raid list.

Spell power by school: Stats.spellPower is one number, but priest gear and consumables carry Shadow-only and Holy-only power (Elixir of Shadow Power +40, Frozen Heart +29 Shadow, Netherpearl/Netherlight Cuffs).

School-specific hit and crit: Shadow Focus (+5% Shadow hit), Holy Precision (+18% Holy hit), Holy Specialization (+5% Holy crit); totalHit() is shared (the paladin extraHit pattern works at spec level).
Per-spell crit multiplier: 2.0x for Shadowform's spells; rules.spellCritMultiplier is global.
Cost stacking: Shadowform's school discount multiplies the additive talent discounts; Inner Focus makes the next spell free; Holy Purpose makes the next Holy Nova free.

Self-damage and self-healing on a DPS spec: SWD backlash (10% max health), Dark Sacrifice (health -> mana), DP and VE healing, Touch of the Grave; needs a player health bar without the attacking dummy.
An execute toggle ('dummy below 20%') for Early Demise and the SWD kill check.
A temporary pet if Shadowfiend is trainable: 15 s, 1.5 s swings, 5% max mana per landed hit (the hunter pet code can serve).
A form state for Shadowform: blocks healing spells and Penance (cosmetic tint optional).

Raid list additions: Judgement of the Crusader (+161 Holy, schoolBonusTaken exists), Divine Spirit (+40 Spirit), Arcane Intellect (+31 Int), Power Infusion from another priest. Optional: a wand auto-repeat (no spell-power scaling).
foreverVsClassic: Shadow Weaving is personal: +2% per stack from you, 5 stacks, 15 s, 33/67/100% (Classic: a 3%/stack raid debuff, 20%/point).
Shadowform: +10% Shadow (was 15%), -50% Shadow mana cost, 2.0x Shadow crits, non-healing spells castable, 40% base mana and a 1.5 s cooldown.
Shadow Word: Death is new and baseline at 32 (15 s, 10% max-health backlash). Devouring Plague is baseline for all races with a 1 min cooldown (was 3 min, Undead only), 0.1 per tick.
